name: Ruff after Python edit
oneLine: Runs ruff check --fix on Python files after Claude edits them.
description: Gates on .py files and runs ruff check --fix, Ruff's combined linter/formatter fix pass. Quietly does nothing when ruff is not installed.
scriptBody:
#!/bin/bash
# ruff-after-edit: run after Claude edits a file. Reads hook JSON from stdin.
set -u
file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')
[ -z "$file" ] && exit 0
[ -f "$file" ] || exit 0
case "$file" in
*.py) ;;
  *) exit 0 ;;
esac
if ! command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exit 0  # formatter not installed; stay silent
fi
ruff check --fix "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1
exit 0
installSteps: Save the script to .claude/hooks/ruff-after-edit.sh and run: chmod +x .claude/hooks/ruff-after-edit.sh
Install the formatter (ruff) and make sure it is on your PATH, plus jq.
Add the config fragment to .claude/settings.json (or use the generator).
testSteps: Positive: ask Claude to edit a matching file (*.py), then check the file was reformatted.
Negative: ask Claude to edit a non-matching file (e.g. README.txt) - the formatter should not run (check with /doctor or debug logs).
verifiedAgainst: Claude Code hooks reference, event/matcher schema checked 2026-09-10

seoDescription: Runs ruff check --fix on Python files after Claude edits them.
